# SCENE_CREATOR (creator): make a brand new Hillvile citizen from scratch.
# Visits every tab, changes lots of options (lists, sliders, the swatch
# grid, cheek toggles, presets), peeks at a locked option, types a name and
# a nickname, tests the voice, randomises, undoes / redoes, turns the
# preview on the turntable, then moves the citizen in. Then the new citizen
# is edited again (makeover) and a cancelled edit leaves the town alone.
scene CREATOR -1
expect-scene CREATOR
wait 20
prof
wait 120
profend creator
